openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead: all leads place the university in Odesa (faculty address Yelisavetynska/Elizavetinska St. 14, Odesa; phone (048) 723-82-64). Structural-change leads instead: (1) 13 Feb 2025 — Cabinet of Ministers decided to attach the National University "Odesa Law Academy" TO ONU (ONU is the absorbing institution; "Перехід відбуватиметься поступово впродовж 2025 року"; reorganisation commission headed by the ONU rector) — lb.ua / osvita.ua / life.pravda.com.ua, Feb 2025; completion not found. (2) MON order 17.12.2025 No. 491-К-25 announced a competition for the post of rector; ONU internal order 23.12.2025 No. 110-02 organised the election; incumbent Vyacheslav Truba (rector 2021–2026) is a candidate; outcome not found.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion: 'Odesa National University' / ONU is a classical university and is NOT Odesa National Medical University (ONMedU, MOH-subordinated, already listed as odesa-national-medical-university). Search for 222 Medicine / 221 Dentistry / 223 Nursing at ONU returned only ONMedU and the communal 'Одеський обласний базовий медичний фаховий коледж' — no medicine, dentistry or nursing programme lead at ONU.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Programme confusion: the Bachelor 'Pharmaceutical chemistry' is a Chemistry (102) degree, not a pharmacist qualification; only the Master 226 'Фармація' leads to the qualification 'Фармацевт'. The faculty page and the international office page describe the offer inconsistently (faculty page shows 102 Pharmaceutical chemistry; international office lists 'Chemistry, Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Chemistry').

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Sub-unit confusion: ONU runs a vocational college (Фаховий коледж ОНУ) with its own MON licence (orders 07.04.2023 No. 116-л; 09.04.2025 No. 30-л); its specialties were not visible — do not attribute any college programme to the university.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Governance in flux: absorption of the National University 'Odesa Law Academy' into ONU (Cabinet decision Feb 2025, gradual transition during 2025; completion not found) and an open rector competition (MON order 17.12.2025 No. 491-К-25; result not found).

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Admissions information found is outdated: the foreign-applicant timetable covers 2025–2026 ('applications from July 1 to October 24, 2025 and contract-form enrolment running to February 28, 2026'); no 2026–2027 rules found.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Restricted-nationality rule in the admission rules: citizens of the Russian Federation, Iran, Belarus and DPRK without a Ukrainian permanent residence permit need an individual MON permit.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Unreliable third-party data: ProZ translator-association pages state 'Fully accredited' and a fee of '$1100' — user-submitted, not to be used.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No English-medium lead for pharmacy; the International Education Centre says English programmes exist at bachelor/master/PhD/DSc level but the results do not name pharmacy among them.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No EDEBO or NAQA registry hit; accreditation status of OP 30292 (226 Master) rests only on ONU-hosted self-assessment and expert-group files whose outcome is not visible.
Missing evidence: No official page was read (onu.edu.ua, imo.onu.edu.ua, chempharm.onu.edu.ua, vstup.onu.edu.ua, mon.gov.ua blocked by network policy); every item above is a search-result lead.
Missing evidence: EDEBO registry entry for ONU and the current licensed volume for 226 Pharmacy (Master).

Missing evidence: NAQA accreditation decision, certificate number and validity dates for OP 30292 Фармація (226 Master) — only ONU-hosted self-assessment and expert-group files were found, outcome not visible.
Missing evidence: Whether 226 Pharmacy (Master) is open to foreign applicants in 2026–2027, the language of instruction, and any English-medium option (none found).
Missing evidence: 2026–2027 admission rules and timetable for foreigners (only the 2025–2026 cycle was found).
Missing evidence: Tuition for foreign applicants (only a 39,548 UAH/year domestic non-budget figure of unstated year and an unreliable $1100 third-party figure were found).
Missing evidence: Completion status of the Odesa Law Academy absorption and the result of the 2026 rector competition.
Missing evidence: Positive confirmation that ONU has no 222 Medicine, 221 Dentistry or 223 Nursing programme (absence is 'not found', not proven).
Missing evidence: Which specialties the ONU vocational college licence covers (to rule out a college-level nursing programme being misattributed).
Missing evidence: Registered official English name spelling (university pages use 'Odessa I.I. Mechnikov', others 'Odesa I. I. Mechnikov/Mechnykov').
Skeptic's note: Accreditation outcome of educational programme 30292 Фармація (226, Master) not shown: only ONU-hosted self-assessment and expert-group files; no NAQA or EDEBO register hit.
Skeptic's note: No lead that 226 Pharmacy admits foreign applicants in 2026-2027 or is taught in English; the International Education Centre's English-programme statement does not name pharmacy.
Skeptic's note: Only 2025-2026 foreign-applicant rules found (applications 1 Jul-24 Oct 2025); 2026-2027 rules not found.

Skeptic's note: Governance in flux: Cabinet decision (Feb 2025) attaching the National University 'Odesa Law Academy' to ONU, completion not found; rector competition announced by MON order 17.12.2025 No. 491-К-25, result not found.
